name: impeccable
tagline: Design director for AI agents: enforces craft floors, overrides timid defaults, and polishes UI
description: Transforms timid, generic frontend code into award-winning, production-grade craft. Equips agents with overdrive, audit, polish, and anti-pattern detectors that eliminate SaaS clichés.
whenToUse: Before writing ANY frontend UI code, or when performing a dedicated visual and motion polish pass on existing surfaces.

name: design-taste-frontend
tagline: Bespoke typographic rhythm, deliberate spatial contrast, and zero AI-slop frontend styling
description: Guides agents to refuse saturated purple gradients, generic cards, and oversized icons. Enforces strict typographic hierarchy, editorial layouts, and tailored color systems.
whenToUse: When designing landing pages, portfolios, developer tools, or redesigning generic dashboards into distinguished editorial experiences.

name: gpt-taste
tagline: Calibrates LLM prose, tone steering, and eliminates sycophantic chatbot cadences
description: Playbook for natural, authoritative, and concise agent writing. Strips robotic conversational filler, unsolicited summaries, and performative cheerfulness.
whenToUse: When prompting agents to write technical documentation, user copy, commit messages, or executive summaries.

name: skill-creator
tagline: Meta-skill for authoring, evaluating, and validating new agent instruction bundles
description: Standardizes the creation of new SKILL.md playbooks. Generates concise YAML frontmatter, scripts, reference guides, and automated evaluation criteria.
whenToUse: When creating a new reusable skill, packaging team best practices, or auditing an existing skill for agent compliance.

name: docx
tagline: Generates beautifully formatted, executive-ready Microsoft Word documents via code
description: Teaches agents how to construct structured Word documents with custom typography styles, multi-column layouts, clean data tables, callout blocks, and footers.
whenToUse: When an agent needs to produce formal proposals, research reports, contracts, or client deliverables in .docx format.

name: pptx
tagline: Architects high-end, human-crafted slide decks with strict layout grids and typography
description: Creates PowerPoint presentations that feel designed by a senior brand strategist. Replaces cheesy bullet lists with asymmetric layouts, editorial titles, and clean metrics.
whenToUse: When generating pitch decks, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), technical architecture presentations, or keynotes.

name: xlsx
tagline: Builds complex financial models, dynamic formulas, and formatted spreadsheet tables
description: Equips agents with deep spreadsheet craft: proper accounting formats, dynamic array formulas, clean zebra striping, conditional formats, and data validation rules.
whenToUse: When creating financial budgets, operational forecasts, data exports, or inventory modeling spreadsheets.

name: pdf
tagline: Compiles pixel-perfect typographic PDFs with vector charts and page break management
description: Guides agents through headless browser rendering, Typst, or LaTeX compilation for publication-quality whitepapers, receipts, and technical manuals.
whenToUse: When outputting printable documents, whitepapers, certificates, or invoices requiring guaranteed pagination.

name: code-review
tagline: Principal engineer rigor for pull requests: race conditions, invariants, and edge cases
description: Inspects diffs for concurrency hazards, subtle regressions, missing boundary validations, memory leaks, and breaking API schema changes.
whenToUse: Before merging pull requests or when reviewing architectural revisions across complex distributed codebases.

name: testing-strategy
tagline: Architects resilient test pyramids: unit invariants, mock boundaries, and synthetics
description: Guides agents to write high-confidence tests that don't flake. Prioritizes state invariant testing over brittle implementation detail assertions.
whenToUse: When setting up testing infrastructure, refactoring legacy components, or designing regression test suites.

name: incident-response
tagline: High-severity outage triage runbook: containment, timeline tracking, and RCA
description: Structured operational playbook for live incidents. Directs agents through isolation, log query synthesis, mitigation validation, and blameless post-mortems.
whenToUse: During production outages, degraded performance incidents, or post-incident root-cause analysis (RCA).

name: debug
tagline: Scientific method debugging: hypothesis formulation, minimal reproductions, and traces
description: Prevents trial-and-error guessing. Forces agents to isolate variables, craft minimal reproducing test cases, inspect stack frames, and prove root cause.
whenToUse: When facing stubborn bugs, race conditions, unexpected null pointers, or elusive Heisenbugs.

name: architecture
tagline: Evaluates architectural trade-offs, system boundaries, and writes durable ADRs
description: Guides agents through trade-off matrices, domain-driven boundaries, eventual consistency models, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
whenToUse: When designing new systems, evaluating database choices, breaking down monoliths, or drafting technical RFCs.
